Results.ReviewText: The Spirit E-210 Gas Grill is the best purchase that I made. It's worth the money and has a great value. I have been using it for about a month and it does a great job of grilling.

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill. This is my second E-210. It’s versatile and compact with great temperatures control. I do miss the removable center grille that accommodated the cast iron skillet.

Results.ReviewText: My husband and I are very happy with our new Weber Spirit.  We also are very happy with the customer service provided when we called to ask a question.   We have owned Webers in the past and will continue as long as Weber products and service continue to be excellent.

Results.ReviewText: This is my second E-210. The first one was for the home and ir has been a great addition. Like it so much I bought this second one for the cottage..... before Weber discontinues this great little BBQ. A bit pricey but you get what you pay for!

Results.ReviewText: Weber responded to my warranty issue very quickly.  The representative who assisted me was ver knowledgeable and well spoken.   The replacement part arrived promptly and I was up & running with my grill in no time flat. Thank You.

Results.ReviewText: Nice compact bbq for the 2 of us. Works great so far.  It is big enough for a family of 4 to 5.  I think when its time to replace I'll stick with the weber but a 3 burner series for a bit larger cooking space for when we have guests.  Still figuring out hot spots, but cooking so far has been great. Arrived with a dent in the lid, but, warranty claims handled the replacement with ease.
Results.Title: Compact BBQ for the 2 of us.

Results.ReviewText: Perfect size for just the two of us plus occasional guests.  LOVE IT...Heats up quickly, cooks GREAT, easy to clean, LOOKS GREAT too.
Results.Title: Perfect for the TWO of us +

Results.ReviewText: Grill works excellently. Even cooking. Easy to use and clean.
Results.Title: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill

Results.ReviewText: Our original Weber Spirit 2 was seven years old, still functional, but starting to show its age. We liked the grill so much, we bought another one just like it!
Results.Title: Stick with what works for you

Results.ReviewText: great grill my first weber works and grills evenly
Results.Title: great grill

Results.ReviewText: I love my Weber grill. It is my first one and I am pleased with everything about it. It cooks great, lights easy and gets as hot as I want. The temp gage is sweet and so is the tank fuel gage. I put it together myself and it was easy. Just follow the instructions one step at a time. I watched a YouTube video of a guy putting his to gather first and it helped with my understand of the Weber Instructions. Yes these grills cost a little more, put the difference in owning a quality grill is well worth the price of a Weber grill. It is winter still. But I have been grilling burgers, steaks, chicken, and toasting buns on the warmer rack. No flare ups was the first thing I noticed.
Results.Title: My first weber grill

Results.ReviewText: Great grill for the money, only improvement would be lights for evening grilling.
Results.Title: Third weber

Results.ReviewText:
Assembly was surprisingly easy. All pieces and the corresponding bag of nuts/ bolts/ are noted by letters A,B,C etc. You only need to open one bag at a time. Assembly was about two hours. I used the box (upside down) as a platform for assembly.

The only issue was the grill door was bent. Customer Service took care of that and sent another door which arrived in two days.

The grill does not heat up as quickly as my last E-210 so preheat for at least 15 minutes before grilling. This might be an issue when searing steaks.
Results.Title: ER-210 Gas Grill

Results.ReviewText: Great small sized grill. Perfect for our use. The customer service is super!
Results.Title: Customer service on our new grill that was damaged

Results.ReviewText: Excellent Grill, easy to assemble and instructions. Watch a You Tube Video of the assembly, which made my assembly smooth, fast and complete. Works great! Purchased the Weber Grill Cover and Rotisserie. My first new grill in 15 years. Love it!
Results.Title: Excellent Size Grill

Results.ReviewText: Love everything about my new grill. Had a small problem with the condition of the door and Weber took care of it immediately. Great customer service. Just wish I knew the purpose of the chain inside the cabinet.
Results.Title: No complaints

Results.ReviewText: Perfect for a small patio. The two burner provides the needed heat for grilling and maintains heat for slow roasting.  Solid Weber construction.
Results.Title: Great for small spaces

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for being a long time Weber fan! We greatly appreciate your feedback regarding the Spirit E-210. We can understand your frustration with the grill taking a long time to preheat and not being able to sear food. We are happy to help. Our suggestion is to wire brush the burner tubes to clear any blockage. Our team is also reaching out with further troubleshooting tips via email. Thank you!

Results.UserLocation: Florida, Minnesota, Virginia and South Dakota
Results.ReviewText: This is my second Weber Sprint grill.  I have two large Weber grills. Weber grills are high quality.  All are good working condition.  Oldest is 12 years old and used 3-4 time a week during the summer.  The newest Weber recently purchased is used 4-5 times a week while we spend winters in Florida.  A few times some parts need replacement but not often.  Parts are easy to get and install. When you compart quality and price, Weber wins.  There are higher grade grills on the market, but at a much higher price. A motor drive spit is really important for us as we grill leg of lamb and whole chickens.
Results.Title: Quality Grills

Results.ReviewText: Great Grill for the price.  Wanted someone a little smaller & this was perfect!
Results.Title: Great size when you aren't the Brady Bunch

Results.ReviewText: The grill heats up fast and recovers the heat quickly after turning the meat.
Results.Title: Quick heat

Results.ReviewText: It is the best grill on the market in this this class. Period

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
